| `Error::ProtocolVersionNotActive` | dash-sdk | + | **breaking**: new variant `{ method: &'static str, required: u32, network: u32, pinned: bool, cause: Option<Box<Error>> }` on the exhaustive `dash_sdk::Error`. Returned before anything is sent, when a request needs a protocol version the network has not yet proven with a verified answer. Not retryable (`can_retry() == false`), and no node is banned. `pinned`: the SDK is pinned below `required`, so no answer can lift the refusal. `cause`: why the version probe failed | an exhaustive `match` needs a new arm: `Error::ProtocolVersionNotActive { method, required, network, pinned, cause } => { if e.is_transient_protocol_version_refusal() { /* retry later */ } else { /* hide the feature until PV14 */ } }` | [PR:5561] |

False for every other error, for a refusal the verified network version explains, and for the SDK's own setup (`ContextProviderNotSet`, `ContextProviderError::Config`, e.g. a non-trusted provider) | use it to decide whether to retry a refused call; see the arm above | [PR:5561] |

Treat `Error::Config` as a caller bug, not a node fault | [PR:5558] |

## gRPC — dapi-grpc
| Keyword | Service | Δ | Change | Migration | Ref |
|---------|---------|---|--------|-----------|-----|
| `Platform.getIdentityKeysRemainingBudgets` | Platform | ± | proto unchanged. Node-side (drive-abci) behaviour for **every** query: a `VersionNotActive` error (feature not active at this protocol version) now answers `INVALID_ARGUMENT` (non-retryable) instead of `UNKNOWN` / `INTERNAL`, with or without a proof; the message is unchanged. In 5.0 the RPC this hits is `getIdentityKeysRemainingBudgets` at protocol 13. Unknown-version mismatches and unsupported request versions stay `UNKNOWN` / `INTERNAL` (retryable on another node). Clients that retry/ban on `UNKNOWN` / `INTERNAL` (rs-dapi-client) no longer ban healthy nodes. The other 12 RPCs added in 5.0 already answered `OK`/`INVALID_ARGUMENT` at PV13. 4.1.x nodes still answer the new RPCs with `UNIMPLEMENTED` | treat `INVALID_ARGUMENT` "not active" answers (any query; in 5.0, the 5.0-added RPCs) as "feature not active yet", not as a node fault | [PR:5557] |

| `WasmSdkErrorKind.ProtocolVersionNotActive` | wasm-sdk error.rs | + | new error kind, appended (numeric value 32), so existing values keep their numbers. `error.name === 'ProtocolVersionNotActive'`. The SDK refused a query the network cannot serve yet, without sending it. `isRetriable` is true only when the SDK could not learn the network's version (the probe failed for a reason that can pass). It is false for a confirmed refusal, a pin below 14, and a non-trusted SDK (its context provider now reports `ContextProviderError::Config`, so it can never verify) | `catch (e) { if (e.name !== 'ProtocolVersionNotActive' \|\| e.isRetriable) throw e; /* PV14 not active: hide the feature */ }` | [PR:5561] |
| `getDataContractsLatestVersions` | wasm-sdk queries | ± | **breaking (behaviour)**: refused with `ProtocolVersionNotActive` until a verified answer shows the network at protocol 14. A fresh client first sends one proved `getEpochsInfo` probe. Same for `getDataContractsByRange`, `getContractGroupInfo`, `getContractGroupMembers`, `getContractGroupsForContract`, `getContractModerationStatus`, `getContractModerationEntries`, `getContractModerationActionCounts`, `getContractDocumentRemovals`, `getContractTeamActions`, `getContractTeamActionSigners`, `getContractFeePots`, `getIdentityKeysRemainingBudgets` (and their `…WithProofInfo` forms), and composite/chained document queries. evo-sdk wrappers (e.g. `sdk.contracts.getLatestVersions`) surface the same error | wrap the call as in the row above. Keep a fallback (e.g. a bundled-contract snapshot) while the network is below PV14 | [PR:5561] |
| `withVersion` | wasm-sdk sdk.rs | ± | a client pinned below 14 (`withVersion(13)`, evo-sdk `version: 13`) now refuses PV14 queries (`ProtocolVersionNotActive`, `isRetriable: false`); before, it sent them. Pinned above the network, document queries fail with kind `Config` once every node has answered at an older version. No node is banned. Docs fixed: an unset version follows the network's (it is not "latest") | do not pin. Leave `withVersion` / `version` unset so the SDK follows the network | [PR:5561] [PR:5560] |
| `WasmSdkErrorKind.Config` | wasm-sdk error.rs | ± | document queries whose shape the selected view cannot verify are refused before sending with kind `Config`, `isRetriable: false`. Before: kind `Proof`, `isRetriable: true`, and nodes banned. ⚠ PR #5558 says "Breaking Changes: None", but the kind and retriability change | treat `Config` from a document query as a query-building bug: fix the select/grouping instead of retrying | [PR:5558] |
| `WasmSdkErrorKind.StaleNode` | wasm-sdk error.rs | ± | a node behind the PV14 upgrade answering a gated query (`BehindProtocolUpgrade`) maps to kind `StaleNode`, `isRetriable: true`.
